title: Saved View Management Pagination And Search Contract

scalability_risk.finding: Saved view management loads the authenticated user's complete saved view collection and renders it in a single table.
scalability_risk.impact: Large saved view collections can reduce scanability and increase page rendering cost.

phase_67b_recommendations: Add request-level search input for saved view name, report label, report key, and common filter display values.
Add optional report_key filtering sourced from ReportSavedViewRegistry labels.
Use Laravel pagination for saved views management instead of eager-loading every record into a collection.
Preserve Phase 66 registry alignment, read-only filters, ownership hardening, and grouped action UX.
Keep query parameters across pagination links.
